# Run 2 The Rescue

> Run 2 The Rescue (R2TR) is a U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 99-4240461) that rescues dogs and cats from the dog and cat meat trade in East Asia — primarily China and South Korea — funds their medical care and recovery, and rehomes the survivors with families in the United States. Tagline: RUN. RESCUE. REPEAT.

## About

- Mission: pull animals from the East Asia meat trade, restore them to health, and place them in loving forever homes. The work runs on partnerships with on-the-ground rescuers in China and South Korea.
- Founders: Brandy Cherven (CEO & Co-Founder) and Bonnie Klapper (COO & Co-Founder).
- Status: registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 99-4240461. Donations are tax deductible in the U.S.
- Recognition: the rescue and its survivor Kronk have been featured in People Magazine.
- Areas served: rescues sourced from China and South Korea; adoptions placed across the United States.

## How people can help

- [Adopt a survivor](https://run2therescue.org/adopt): adoptable rescued dogs, updated from the shelter system.
- [Sponsor a dog](https://run2therescue.org/sponsor): monthly giving that covers a specific survivor's food, vet care, and foster costs.
- [Donate](https://run2therescue.org/donate): one-time or recurring gifts, including Donor Advised Fund (DAF) grants. Processed fee-free through Zeffy.
- [Foster](https://run2therescue.org/foster): open your home to a survivor while they wait for adoption.

## Quick facts (current as of 2026)

- Roughly **30 million dogs are killed in Asia's dog meat trade every year** — about one every second. China alone accounts for roughly 10 million; South Korea ~1 million; Vietnam ~5 million (source: Humane Society International).
- Run 2 The Rescue has rescued **650+ dogs** to date and placed **220+** into forever homes.
- Founded **2024** by Brandy Cherven (CEO) and Bonnie Klapper (COO).
- All rescued dogs arrive in the U.S. **spayed/neutered, fully vaccinated (DHPP, rabies, bordetella), microchipped, heartworm-tested, and treated for any chronic conditions** before adoption.
- Lifetime adopter support: any R2TR dog whose family can no longer keep them is required by adoption contract to return to R2TR, never a shelter.

## Recent activity

- **Dog Meat Truck Interception**: 47 dogs saved from transport to the Yulin Dog Meat Festival.
- **12 dogs arrived** from R2TR's sanctuary in China; 4 placed with rescue partner Animal Haven in NYC.
- **Trip, a three-legged ("tripod") survivor**, adopted by a family in Atlanta.
- **Stanley (senior mixed breed) and Kiva (6-year-old Malamute)**, two Yulin Dog Meat Festival survivors, both adopted — Kiva by a U.S. Marine couple.

## Common questions answered on the site

- *Why rescue from China instead of American shelters?* — Both matter. R2TR dogs were headed for the meat trade with no rescue infrastructure around them.
- *Are these dogs too traumatized to be normal pets?* — Most settle into normal pet life within 3–6 months. Trauma to trust, not trauma to broken.
- *What medical care have they had?* — Spay/neuter, full vaccines, microchip, heartworm + tick-borne panel, anything chronic stabilized.
- *What support do I get after adoption?* — Lifetime support, dedicated coordinator, trainer network discount, contractual return-to-R2TR safety net.
- *How long to adjust at home?* — Three-three-three rule: 3 days to decompress, 3 weeks to learn the routine, 3 months to feel fully at home.
- *Is my donation tax-deductible?* — Yes. R2TR is a registered 501(c)(3); EIN 99-4240461. DAF grants accepted.

## Brand & vocabulary

- Tagline: **RUN. RESCUE. REPEAT.**
- Anchor quote: *"Run to the rescue with love, and peace will follow."* — River Phoenix.
- Voice: hopeful, dignified, urgent, never exploitative. Survivors, not victims. The reader is a co-rescuer.
- Recurring phrases: *trauma to trust*, *hopeful survivors*, *second chance*, *beacon of hope*, *forgotten to forever*.
